7900.title: Long awake stalls are discarded by the duration-only suspension veto
7900.rootCauseOneLine: A wall-clock sample gap of at least 65,000 ms vetoes a measured monotonic stall; the histogram has already been reset, so that observation is lost.

prReviews.topFinding: Addresses the verified veto; linked branch was not executed.

7900.proposedFix: Preserve measured awake stalls and report corroborated suspension separately.
7900.caveats: No physical sleep or macOS verification. An already-open linked PR was reviewed statically, not executed. Reproduction source and output are inline per reports repository policy.
